headline: Higher sales and operating profit, lower net profit
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 12.01T, up 18.3% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 1.14T, up 15.0% y/y, while net income was KRW 558.0B, down 1.5% y/y.
summary_long: Third-party coverage reports operating profit about 18% above the one-month consensus of KRW 971.7B. The construction segment's revenue and operating profit rose 44% and 150% y/y; the trading segment reported KRW 4.2T revenue and KRW 99B operating profit. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary results. Shard operating income (KRW 2.19T) does not match the reported KRW 1.14T and is not used.
